_readme: Photographer portfolio for the couple-shoot page. Only entries with "approved": true are shown, and only if the image file exists in images/photography/portfolio/. With no approved entries the page shows a plain 'portfolio coming soon' note instead. To add a photo: put the file in images/photography/portfolio/, add an entry below, set approved to true ONLY once the photographer has given written permission and everyone clearly visible in the photo has agreed to its use, record who approved it and when, then run: python3 build.py. Fields: file (name inside images/photography/portfolio/, .jpg/.jpeg/.png/.webp), location (srinagar or patnitop), alt (a plain description of the photo), approved (true/false), approved_by (who gave permission), approved_on (YYYY-MM-DD), credit (optional, shown as a photo credit). Example entry (leave out of the real list): {"file": "example.jpg", "location": "srinagar", "alt": "Couple on a shikara on Dal Lake", "approved": true, "approved_by": "Photographer name", "approved_on": "2026-11-01", "credit": "Photographer name"}
